d: Designated person to operate and drive the loading shovel within the working yard area. To ensure all raw materials are moved and stocked in the correct piles and feed material in the correct plant hoppers for concrete production
q: Understand and positively promote the companies SHE policy statements including Golden Goals
Ensure that all site activities are in compliance with Health and Safety procedures/method statements and relevant legislation for employees and non employees
Ensure all employees and visitors at all times adhere to the Companies rules covering the use and wearing of PPE and or applicable site rules
Record and bring to the attention all Safety violations (including vehicular and near misses) and pass on to the Company and site Safety Officer
Attend weekly toolbox talks as required
Ensure that they observe all relevant traffic legislation
Must hold a valid car drivers license
Minimum of 1 year experience as a shovel operator
Safety awareness in the operation of heavy plant in the presence of ground personnel.
r: Operate the loading shovel in accordance with the company procedures and the manufacturer's procedures
Carry out daily checks and maintain the shovel loader in accordance with the company and manufactures procedures
Instruction shall be given via the batcher and shipper of which aggregates are required to be filled into the concrete bins for concrete production
Ensure all materials are fed and stocked correctly in the bays and bins without overspills and contamination
Ensure the stocking and loading areas are kept in a tidy manner assisted by the labourers
Carryout instructions as directed by senior members of staff
